title: dnaa-9 diagnostics — box counts, cell mass, bulk DnaA-ATP (n=4, K=30)
caption: Cooperativity n=4, K=30 nM. Panels: cell mass; oriC count at full resolution (every initiation is +1 — the apparent 1->3 is downsampling of the fast 1->2->3 re-firing); oriC-low bound-box COUNT with the 8xn_oriC line (each origin fires at its own 8/8); bulk free DnaA-ATP; and the GLOBAL occupancy fraction (which dips to ~0.6 when one origin is full and another refilling — a global-average artifact, not partial firing).
interpretation: Clarifies Rashmi's two questions: the trigger fires per-origin at full 8/8 occupancy (the ~0.6 is the global average across a full + a refilling origin), and every oriC step is +1 (the 1->3 is a plot-resolution artifact of the over-replicating re-firing).
